propositions: The admission cap config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000) should be read by a new third consumer at save time to warn users when descriptions exceed the configured limit and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, before review time rejects the ticket.

When a description exceeds the configured cap and the plan-review gate is enabled for the project, a warning must be emitted at create/edit time (via CLI stderr, library logger, and MCP result field) stating the length, cap, and that claim will require a passing review that refuses admission until the description is shortened.

The save-time warning must never block or alter the write; it degrades gracefully to no warning when the gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, the ticket type is exempt, or any error occurs.
The warning must use the exact same gate-applicability probe (_plan_review_gate_applies) that the claim path uses, so the warning cannot promise a block the gate would not enforce.
